OwnCode v0.5.0 brings a more responsive terminal interface, four coordinated palettes, and recoverable message drafts.

## Interface
- Refreshed default OwnCode palette plus Midnight, Ember, and Grove, each with light and dark colors.
- Theme previews with contrast checks and corrected initial dialog sizing.
- Consistent spacing across message cards, menus, and the composer.
- More space around the command footer; response model and duration metadata sit below the message card.
- Compact successful read tools with expandable details and a new-message indicator when browsing history.

## Performance and sessions
- Indexed message updates, batched tool events, and cached unchanged transcript frames.
- Local fixtures measured about 92% less time for the 1,000-tool activity check and 14% less time for the five-worker interaction benchmark. These figures do not measure provider inference speed.
- Worker status, latest activity, and duration in the agent list.
- Separate main and aggregate TPS, time to first event, and tool wait duration.
- Session draft text saved under ~/.owncode/drafts. Attachments stay in memory and do not restore after restart.
- Exit summaries no longer wait for service cleanup; shutdown runs once, with a session snapshot fallback.

## Install or upgrade
```sh
brew update
brew install muratmirgun/tap/owncode
# If already installed:
brew upgrade owncode
```

macOS and Linux archives support arm64 and x86_64. Debian and RPM packages are also available. Verify downloads with checksums.txt.

OwnCode and the optional Jev compaction integration remain experimental.
